recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed; future animal-genderstatus or patient-animal changes should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack.

Current core Patient source links to the standard patient-animal extension, while the FHIR Extension Pack now maintains patient-animal and animal-genderstatus. That extension-pack source contains code unknown and keeps genderStatus optional with an example binding.
